study: Frozen Go2 models, fresh-seed robustness replication
primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean over paired seeds of after minus before fall probability, among push-eligible trials
primary_test: Exact two-sided paired-seed sign-flip test, alpha 0.05; exchangeability/symmetry of paired differences under null assumed
confidence_interval: 95 percent paired-seed cluster percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples; descriptive interval, may differ slightly from exact test
secondary_fall_tests: Holm correction across the other 15 pushed conditions; no-push control descriptive
model_order: Odd list index before/after, even list index after/before
incomplete_run_policy: No outcome-dependent stopping or extension. Analyze only fully completed seed pairs, disclose all incomplete runs and failed force audits. No inferential conclusion with fewer than 12 complete seed pairs.
protocol: Unmodified push_experiment.py and push_protocol.py; 0.5 m/s, force at 5 s for 0.2 s, 15 s horizon; four directions x 0.25/0.5/1/2 BW plus no push
